caption: M₂ checks w = 000111 in 3 rounds of at most 12 cells each, so 36 steps in all; M₁ needs only 7. That puts M₁ in TIME(n) and M₂ in TIME(n²), while both use 6 cells of space.

spec.aria: Timeline in steps: machine M₁ finishes the word 000111 in 7 steps, while machine M₂ works in three rounds of up to 12 cells each, reaching 12, 24 and finally 36 steps.
